brief: The thirteenth statue holding a thin chisel; Lubdhaka's foreman crouched at an inscription on the plinth with his lamp beside him, frowning; Dādī kneeling beside him and pointing to one letter; Śuka on the plinth.

expected: रिक्तपाणिर् न पश्येत राजानं भिषजं गुरुम्
brief: The thirty-two statues standing in a ring around a lit stone throne; Lubdhaka with one foot on the first step and his foreman beside him; a small basalt spirit holding out a scroll with a line on it to the travellers; Dādī and Śuka stepping forward; warm light from inside the throne.

The twenty-second statue holding a small bronze mirror in which a row of names glows instead of a face; Dādī leaning in to read them; Śuka reading over her shoulder; Lubdhaka's foreman copying names into his notebook.
The fifth statue holding a carved stone oar upright, a faint wave pattern carved on her base; Śuka tilting his head; Dādī pointing at the small curl on a rubbing of an inscription; morning light.
